stories.detail: Owen and Jeremy have the Whalan family covered at both ends of the draw.

stories.detail: 9 spots clawed back by Mark Sayer, hanging on through the siren like Tedesco's Roosters.

stories.detail: Good to see William Coghlan up from Royal Sydney GC, and we hope the greens were kind.

stories.detail: A run of 6 straight scoring holes - smooth sailing

stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 5s - bombing them and cashing in

stories.detail: Answered every wipe with points next hole - never let one become two

stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s AND 3s - a round that covers all four food groups

stories.detail: 3 twos in a row on holes 4, 5 & 6 - starting to look comfortable

stories.detail: 5 straight two-pointers on holes 2-6

stories.detail: 3 in a row on holes 4, 5 & 6 - sticking to the 1-point script

stories.detail: 3-pointers on holes 2 & 3 - this is momentum

stories.detail: Back-to-back 3-pointers on holes 2 & 3

stories.detail: Wipe then 3-pointer on holes 10 & 11 - drama then redemption

stories.detail: 3-pointer on hole 1, 1-pointer on hole 2

stories.detail: 3 1-pointers in a row on holes 9, 10 & 11

stories.detail: One good hole then one bad on holes 9 & 10 - the course charges a fee for everything

stories.title: Slipping Away
stories.detail: Jeremy Whalan led at three-quarter time, and 2nd to 12th says the closing stanza got away.
